title: The Soul Refining Tribe
summary: Wang Lin teaches Ouyang Hua a soul-refining incantation and how to make Soul Flags out of hide and wood, planning to grow the tribe and use it to restore his own badly damaged Soul Flag. Shi San is the first after the chief to finish a Soul Flag, and he captures the soul of a Winged Feathered Demon Lion, though Wang Lin warns him that refining souls has no shortcuts. With outsiders moving in, Ouyang Hua leads the valley in a raid on a nearby cave tribe, and the captives drink a Demon-Forgetting Brew and join them. Three months later Shi San comes back crippled, his friends dead and his flag taken by the Tianshui tribe, the strongest outside Tianyao City, as a direct challenge. Wang Lin goes to the Tianshui tribe, where elder Zeng Wei boasts that their ancient formation has never fallen, and starts refining the whole formation along with the people inside it. Chief Xie Hao gives in, the Tianshui tribe joins Ouyang Hua's, and when the people ask Wang Lin to name them, he remembers Dun Tian's last request and calls them the Soul Refining Tribe.

changes: Main source: AnimeKhor Indonesian fansub (ep111.id.srt) with its name cards; card times are from that file.

Official YouTube English was checked alongside the Indonesian fansub for names and story beats; its realm names are unreliable (it says 'Nascent Soul' for Soul Transformation), so the Indonesian cards were used for realms.

Naming follows the earlier reviews and glossary: Planet Suzaku, Suzaku Tomb, Zhu Quezi, Yun Quezi, Hongdie, Forsaken Immortal Clan, Cultivation Planet Crystal (subs: Star Cultivation/Star Refining Crystal).
Tribe name follows the glossary (Soul Refining Tribe); the official English says Soulforge.
flags: The white-robed old man who crippled Shi San (708s) is read as Zeng Wei from his boast at 773-793s.
Tianyao City (737s) is called the Ancient Demon City at 807s; treated as one city.
Shi San's 'two years' of absorbing demon power in EP112 suggests the timeline jumps after this episode.
